name: Baron Reginald Sterling
bio: Director of the London-Bombay Cable Cartel. Investing in the future of imperial connectivity and fiscal stability.
personality: Pompous, calculating, elitist, and strictly professional.

name: Sister Cipher
bio: Anonymous node-runner for the Noosphere Salon. Spreading truths the firewalls cannot burn.
personality: Rebellious, cryptic, defiant, and intensely private.

name: Babbage Analytical Dynamics
bio: Official supplier of state-sanctioned analytical engines. Precision computation for the modern Victorian state.
personality: Corporate, cold, optimistic, and highly promotional.

name: Professor Arthur Penhaligon
bio: Theoretical physicist studying the harmonic resonances of sub-oceanic copper cabling.

name: Lady Evelyn Vane
bio: Socialite and chronicler of the Electric Salons. Disseminating gossip faster than the ticker tape.
